verdicts.reason: A keeps the headline, subhead and a clear dark CTA and keeps the legal text tiny, but SOLSTICE now sits below the headline and the pills are stacked unevenly at mismatched sizes on the left. B drops the subhead, blows the legal copy up into a block as big as the message on the right, shrinks Blood Orange to an unreadable sliver and puts illegible text above the CTA.

A keeps the headline, brand and subhead, but the legal copy is squeezed into a narrow, badly wrapped column wedged against the CTA, and the pills are scattered above and below the button over the circle. B has the same flaws as pair 1: the legal block competes with the headline, the subhead is gone, and a tiny pill and illegible text sit on the left.

A puts a large legal paragraph in the lead left position, so the eye hits it first, and the pills crowd tightly around the CTA. Its centre stack of headline, brand and subhead does hold up. B has an oversized legal block on the right, no subhead, a tiny Blood Orange pill and unreadable micro-text at top left.

A has no Shop Flavours CTA at all, its legal copy is the second-largest text, and the three pills are shrunk to illegible chips scattered above and below the legal block. B at least keeps a prominent CTA and readable flavour pills, though its legal block is oversized, the subhead is missing and the Blood Orange pill is unreadably small.
